_comment: Live versions of the blocks that have a feed brand (ouka, cherry, aureum, astraea, tsubomi, halia) and of the two Algorab blocks with no feed yet (algorab_audio, algorab_io), on 2026-11-17. The release-notes gate (scripts/release_notes_gate.py) requires three-section notes for a block only from the version after these on.

Not listed on purpose: corvus6 and agent (gated directly), pack (Alpha: its history is data/changelog.json), launcher (its own notes gate), xhard, noctua, punchy, fabric_api (no feed brand; punchy and fabric_api are third-party pins).
